selection: Union of the R8 seed selections. C4 counterparts verified by cold initial state and density-weight ratio; outcome-conditioned population, not total yield.
origin: First saved cold reference ahead of the laser. An initial particle position, not an injection event or trapping position.
statistics: Native charge in each case. Radius median and 10–90% band use common R8 weights, with at least 10% of the original reference charge inside the grid.
filtered: Isolated filled markers use filtered diagnostics; line curves use unfiltered histories. Not recorded is distinct from observed outside the grid.
